action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
f=$(ls /workspaces/workspace/lib/auth.rb /workspaces/workspace/app/models/auth.rb 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "FILE: $f"
grep -n "def initialize" -A 12 "$f" | head -30
grep -n "def lookup\|def valid\|def verify" -A 8 "$f" | head -40
' 2>&1
